term: A4 separate-possibility transfer, modal classification and reductio scope
resolution: The reported P-transfer combines separate possibilities of first exemplification and a caused P-bearer into possible caused first exemplification; it does not conjoin their worlds or assume the bearer was caused to acquire P. Contingency-as-P needs its own admissibility/classification interpretation across histories. A4C steps3–14 remain under the no-possible-Necessary-Being supposition; only steps14–17 discharge it to conclude possible Necessary Being. No unconditional Scenario causal opportunity or hypothetical causal witness survives merely by that discharge. Classifying a caused thing as contingent needs domain correspondence with the source cause-capable Necessary Being class. A prior explanatory condition is not automatically an earlier existing concrete individual or complete sufficient explanation. For the main A4C reading, nonrigid none-to-some and explicit essential-state event scope remain; no actual beginning, universal PSR, new S5/frame theorem, N-to-Box-N identity or rigid actual necessary witness is attributed. The rooted-causal-property stress outline remains conditional and unverified, with possible first-P exemplification unestablished; it is not a source inconsistency certificate. A4C3 repeats the property-prefix words under the revised κ/complement class. Its no-possible-κ-Necessary-Being supposition remains through3–14; at17 only possible κ Necessary Being is discharged, feeding final automatic actuality without exporting the hypothetical cause at13. The revised event title retains state-change wording but omits the main explicit essential-state phrase: attribute neither that qualification nor its negation. Ordinary A4 and direct A3 revised-causability arguments are not silently identified with this revised property reductio.
